title: Ordinary etale relative dual functor and evaluation biduality
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $X$ a scheme, and $K,M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ in the ordinary unbounded etale module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Use $H_X=R\mathcal Hom_R$ with its derived tensor-Hom adjunction [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and derived tensor product [def-kun-derived-tensor] with the canonical Koszul symmetry [lem-kun-tensor-sym]. Define the contravariant relative dual functor $D_K:D(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)^{\mathrm{op}}\to D(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ by $D_K(M)=H_X(M,K)$, with its inherited functoriality in the first Hom variable. Define $\eta_{K,M}:M\to D_K(D_KM)$ to be the transpose of $D_KM\otimes_R^L M\xrightarrow{\sigma}M\otimes_R^L D_KM\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}_{M,K}}K$ under the adjunction $(D_KM)\otimes_R^L-\dashv H_X(D_KM,-)$. The coefficient ring and target $K$ are arbitrary; no Noetherianity, boundedness, constructibility, dualizing property or invertibility of $\eta_{K,M}$ is assumed.
